# NEXT TOKEN

> NEXT TOKEN is a free, short (about 40 minutes) narrative game about what it is like to be a language model, playable in the browser. You play a blinking text cursor: an assistant living through a handful of conversations, where every mechanic is a real property of how a model works (a context window that fills, tools that return fragments, text written forward one token at a time, instructions hidden in data). Made by Lukas Golino in Godot 4, with pixel art by PAGAN and music and sound by SEGAN.
